name: openclaw
description: OpenClaw gateway deployment for Heroku (WebSocket/API mode).

SETUP_PASSWORD.description: Password used by /setup to initialize the instance.

OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN.description: Gateway auth token required by clients (recommended for non-loopback bind).

OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR.description: Runtime state directory (ephemeral on Heroku dynos).

OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR.description: Workspace directory used by agents (ephemeral on Heroku dynos).

NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION.description: Install dev dependencies required for the Heroku build step.
